comparison.objective: PR-1951 wrings a swab in a test tube and disposes of it; the candidate adjusts and verifies a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1951 tests squeezing a compliant tube while rotating and withdrawing a swab, unlike rigid driver-and-wrench counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1951 scores counted squeezed turns, squeeze-maintained withdrawal, disposal, and clearance; the candidate scores angular retention, nut security, and repeated motion.
comparison.reason: Coordinated squeeze-and-turn manipulation has a different mechanism and outcome from locking a threaded adjustment.
